name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively maintained with frequent patch releases across multiple supported branches. The latest release is v0.65.6 (Open Source) / v1.65.6 (Enterprise), released on November 18, 2024. Multiple branches (58.x, 64.x, 65.x) are receiving concurrent patch updates, indicating long-term support across versions. Release notes are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases, and both Docker images and JAR downloads are provided for each edition.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license (Metabase Commercial Software License)
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across 3 active branches as recently as November 18, 2024
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed cloud) is available at metabase.com
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported as Enterprise/Pro features
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, MongoDB, SQLite, Oracle, Druid, Presto/Trino, Spark SQL, and more via drivers

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Offers far more advanced visualization and enterprise features than Metabase but comes with significant licensing costs and no open-source option.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Tightly integrates with dbt for a metrics-first approach, making it more structured than Metabase but requiring a dbt workflow as a prerequisite.
